studies.dataset: Bitstamp BTC/USD spot, Kaggle v706 normalized by ff137
studies.finding: Weekly cut fills from 188 to 80. At base costs its net Sharpe was 0.081 higher than daily momentum and 0.261 lower than passive BTC/cash. Both paired 95% intervals include zero. The accounts held different positions on 292 daily closes.
studies.next_action: Use the position-day counts and gross and net comparisons to examine how the slower schedule changed timing and exposure.

studies.dataset: Bitstamp BTC/USD spot, Kaggle v706 normalized by ff137
studies.finding: Rebalancing to 50% BTC on positive Mondays reduced base-cost maximum drawdown by 19.43 percentage points versus a half-funded weekly account (paired 95% interval +0.66 to +23.82). It also finished $4,008 lower per $10,000 invested.
studies.next_action: Prespecify prospective paper observation of both accounts, retaining all scheduled decisions and omissions. Cross-asset validation still requires a qualified market.
studies.question: Would a 50% BTC target on positive-signal Mondays reduce drawdown beyond investing half the starting capital in the existing weekly rule?
